title: Status response
requirement: The DUT shall respond to a valid status request.
acceptance_criteria: Response status is ok and state is READY.

title: Status timing
requirement: The DUT shall respond to a valid status request within 250 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Measured monotonic duration is less than or equal to 0.250 seconds.

title: Unsupported command
requirement: The DUT shall reject an unsupported or incomplete command without terminating.
acceptance_criteria: An error response is returned and a subsequent status request succeeds.

title: Malformed JSON
requirement: The DUT shall reject malformed JSON without terminating.
acceptance_criteria: INVALID_JSON is returned and a subsequent valid request succeeds.

title: Test cleanup
requirement: The test harness shall terminate the DUT after the test session.
acceptance_criteria: The process is terminated or force-killed during fixture teardown.
